title: The edge map H^1(Y, f_*G) -> H^1(X, G) is injective
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $f_*$ be the direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], $f^{-1}$ the inverse image with counit $\varepsilon_G:f^{-1}f_*G\to G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and $f^*:H^1(Y_{\Et},f_*G)\to H^1(X_{\Et},f^{-1}f_*G)$ the pullback on cohomology [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Then the edge map $H^1(\varepsilon_G)\circ f^*:H^1(Y_{\Et},f_*G)\to H^1(X_{\Et},G)$ is injective (cohomology as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]).
